notes: address_raw/size_raw are verbatim. Tokens are 7-bit bytes, MSB first, right-aligned (shorter strings have implied leading 00s).
Repeated <address> in a <struct> = array instances (e.g. 4 Tones).
'$name', '$address', '$size' are macro placeholders filled by the referencing <struct> (A8EE.exe: 'Unable to resolve macros').
ui_bindings are derived from <control> elements; they show how the Editor DISPLAYS a value, and are evidence, not hardware facts.
